mechanism: Valbenazine may increase sympathomimetic effects and valbenazine's metabolism via CYP3A4 could theoretically be affected, though levothyroxine primarily affects thyroid hormone levels which may alter drug clearance in thyroid-sensitive patients.
action: Monitor thyroid function and clinical response; levothyroxine dosing may require adjustment if valbenazine significantly affects metabolism or if hyperthyroidism symptoms emerge.
